title: Graph Workflow Protocol Schema
description: JSON Schema definition for the Graph Workflow Protocol

parameter.description: Unified parameter definition, used in three contexts: inputs (formal declaration), arguments (actual passing), outputs (output declaration). Applicable fields vary by context

name.description: Parameter name, must be unique within scope

type.description: Parameter type for type checking and validation

value.description: Parameter value, supports template variable references

default.description: Default value when no argument is provided

path.description: Read value from a file path

from.description: Reference an artifact from another task

artifactSource.description: Artifact storage source using type + config pattern, consistent with executor design. Built-in types: oss/local/http; extensible via engine plugin

type.description: Storage type. Built-in: oss, local, http; extensible via engine plugin

config.description: Storage configuration, structure determined by type

arguments.description: Actual parameters passed at call site. Parameter names must match the target's inputs (by-name binding)

inputs.description: Formal parameter declarations on a template. Access via {{inputs.parameters.<name>}}

parameters.description: Formal parameter declarations. Parameters without 'default' are required

phase.description: Execution phase: Pending (awaiting), Running, Succeeded, Failed (business failure), Error (system error), Skipped (condition false), Timeout

outputs.description: Template output declarations. Must be explicitly declared — if omitted, no outputs are exposed to the parent scope. Contains engine auto-populated status fields (readOnly) and user-declared business outputs (parameters/artifacts)

msg.description: Human-readable result message or error details

progress.description: Execution progress, e.g. '3/5'. For DAG: completed tasks/total tasks; for Loop: completed iterations/total iterations (auto-populated by engine)

failed.description: Whether to continue subsequent tasks when this task fails

error.description: Whether to continue subsequent tasks when this task errors

timeout.description: Whether to continue subsequent tasks when this task times out

succeeded.description: Success condition expression. Marks as Succeeded when true

failed.description: Business failure condition expression. Marks as Failed when true

error.description: System error condition expression. Marks as Error when true (usually no need to customize; engine handles infrastructure exceptions by default)

type.description: Executor type. Engine routes to the corresponding executor pool based on type + resources

name.description: Built-in or custom function name, e.g. sleep

awaitConfig.description: External signal wait configuration. Pauses execution until an external signal is received

message.description: Notification message with template variable support

task.description: Unified execution unit. Either references a template by name or inlines an executor. Exactly one of template or executor must be set

name.description: Task name, unique within its parent DAG

inputs.description: Template input declarations (when task is used as a standalone template)

template.description: Referenced template name (DAG or Loop). Mutually exclusive with executor

executor.description: Inline executor definition. Mutually exclusive with template

dependencies.description: Prerequisite task names within the same DAG

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the referenced template's inputs

when.description: Condition expression; task is skipped when false

retry.description: Retry strategy. Falls back to workflowSpec.retry if not set

resources.description: Resource requirements for inline executor mode

outputs.description: Output declarations for inline executor mode. Not needed for template reference mode

oneOf.description: Template reference mode: delegate to a DAG or Loop template by name
Inline executor mode: embed an executor definition directly for leaf execution

outputs.description: Template output declarations. If omitted, no outputs are exposed to parent scope

entrypoints.description: Entry task name(s). If omitted, engine auto-infers tasks with no dependencies

continueOn.description: DAG-level continue-on-failure policy, can be overridden by task.continueOn

loop.description: Loop definition. Mode determined by field presence: repeatCondition → conditional loop (doWhile); items/itemsFrom → data parallel (forEach)

outputs.description: Template output declarations. If omitted, no outputs are exposed to parent scope

repeatCondition.description: Repeat condition expression; evaluated after each iteration, loop continues when true

items.description: Static iteration list for data parallel mode; mutually exclusive with itemsFrom

itemsFrom.description: Dynamic iteration list source (template variable resolving to JSON array); mutually exclusive with items

concurrency.description: Concurrency for data parallel: 1=serial (default), N=up to N concurrent, 0=unlimited

maxIterations.description: Maximum iteration limit to prevent infinite loops

body.description: Body template name (DAG, Loop, or Task type)

arguments.description: Arguments passed to body template's inputs. Iterator variables and workflow globals are available in value expressions

aggregate.description: Output aggregation strategy for multi-iteration results

oneOf.description: Conditional loop mode (doWhile semantics): has repeatCondition, no items/itemsFrom
Data parallel mode (forEach semantics): has items, no repeatCondition
Data parallel mode (forEach semantics): has itemsFrom, no repeatCondition

aggregate.description: Output aggregation strategy for loop templates

strategy.description: Aggregation strategy: last=use last iteration output (default), first=use first iteration output, list=collect each declared parameter across all iterations into an ordered JSON array (by iteration index)

parameters.description: List of output parameter names to include in aggregation; omit to aggregate all output parameters

template.description: Reusable template union. Exactly one of dag/task/loop must be set. name, inputs, outputs are owned by each type

dag.description: DAG type: contains a sub-graph of tasks. Carries its own name, inputs, outputs

task.description: Task type: execution unit. Carries its own name, inputs, outputs

loop.description: Loop type: iteratively executes a body template. Carries its own name, inputs, outputs

oneOf.description: dag type template: contains a sub-graph of tasks forming a DAG
task type template: the execution unit bridging orchestration to execution. Can inline an executor or reference DAG/Loop templates. Task→Task is forbidden
loop type template: iteratively executes a body template referenced by name (DAG/Loop/Task). Supports conditional loop (doWhile) and data parallel (forEach)

onStart.description: Triggered when workflow/task starts. Context: hook.workflow.name/id, hook.workflow.parameters.*

onSuccess.description: Triggered when workflow/task succeeds. Context: hook.workflow.*, hook.workflow.outputs.*, hook.workflow.duration

onFailure.description: Triggered on business failure (returned Failed). Context: hook.workflow.*, hook.trigger.node/phase/code/msg

onError.description: Triggered on system error (returned Error). Context: hook.workflow.*, hook.trigger.node/phase/code/msg

onExit.description: Triggered on exit (regardless of success, failure, or error). Context: hook.workflow.*, hook.workflow.phase/duration

hook.description: Hook definition. Engine auto-injects system context (hook.workflow.*, hook.trigger.*)

entrypoint.description: Entry template name (DAG, Loop, or Task type). Use {{workflow.parameters.*}} to access global arguments

arguments.description: Workflow-level global arguments. Accessible from any depth via {{workflow.parameters.<name>}}

priority.description: Workflow priority; higher values indicate higher priority

maxNestedDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth for container templates (DAG/Loop). Inline executor does not count

workflowTemplateRef.description: Reference to an external WorkflowTemplate; mutually exclusive with entrypoint+templates

namespace.description: Namespace of the WorkflowTemplate; defaults to the current workflow's namespace when omitted

schedule.description: Cron expression, e.g. '0 * * * *' (triggers every hour on the hour)

concurrencyPolicy.description: Concurrency policy when the previous schedule has not finished: Allow=allow concurrent runs, Forbid=skip this run, Replace=terminate previous and start new instance

startingDeadlineSeconds.description: Starting deadline in seconds; skip this run if not started within this time

successfulJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of successful workflow runs to retain in history

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of failed workflow runs to retain in history

suspend.description: Whether to suspend scheduling (resource is not deleted, only triggering is paused)

workflowSpec.description: Workflow spec created on each scheduled trigger

workflowMetadata.description: Metadata template for generated Workflow instances

oneOf.title: WorkflowTemplate
oneOf.description: Reusable workflow template that can be referenced by Workflow via workflowTemplateRef
